en.请输入服务器的用户名和密码。: For non-GitHub servers, enter your username and password.
en.输入个人访问令牌以连接 GitHub。令牌验证成功后将自动保存到账号列表。: Enter a personal access token to authenticate with GitHub. The token will be validated and saved to your accounts.
en.在 GitHub → Settings → Developer settings: Generate a token at GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens.
en.选择浅色、深色或跟随系统主题，设置会自动保存。: Choose light, dark, or follow system. Settings are saved automatically.
en.选择按钮、强调色和高亮使用的色调。: Pick a color palette for accents, buttons, and highlights.
en.在当前主题的基础上微调配色，或写入自己的 CSS。覆盖叠加在基底预设之上，切换预: Fine-tune the current theme's colors, or inject your own CSS. Overrides sit on top of the base preset, so switching presets keeps them.
en.自定义样式已停用。在恢复之前，这里的设置都不会生效。: Custom style is suspended. Nothing set here takes effect until you resume it.
en.本窗口以安全外观模式打开，自定义样式在此不生效，其它窗口不受影响。: This window was opened in safe appearance mode, so custom style is ignored here. Other windows are unaffected.
en.正在编辑浅色模式的取值。切换到深色模式可单独设置深色。: Editing light mode values. Switch the app to dark mode to set its own.
en.正在编辑深色模式的取值。切换到浅色模式可单独设置浅色。: Editing dark mode values. Switch the app to light mode to set its own.
en.从 sm 到 4xl 的整套圆角尺寸都由它派生，一个滑块即可改变全局圆角。: Drives the whole radius scale from sm to 4xl, so one slider rounds the entire app.
en.高级功能。自定义 CSS 会压过所有内置样式，写坏可能导致界面不可用。: Advanced feature. Custom CSS overrides every built-in style and can make the interface unusable.
en.主题采用 shadcn 的 registry:theme 格式，可以直接粘贴任意: Themes use shadcn's registry:theme format, so you can paste any shadcn theme here and use exported ones in any shadcn project.
en.粘贴 shadcn 的 registry:theme 条目、裸的 light/d: Paste a shadcn registry:theme item, a bare light/dark object, or a flat token map.
en.无法写入剪贴板: Could not copy to the clipboard
en.无法读取剪贴板，请手动粘贴: Could not read the clipboard, paste manually
en.这段 JSON 里没有可用的主题变量: No usable theme tokens found in that JSON

en.内容过大，无法保存，请精简到上限以内。: Too large to save. Trim it below the limit.
en.剥离后仍检测到 @import（转义写法），请手动移除后再保存。: An @import rule survived removal (escaped syntax). Remove it to save.
en.没有解析出任何规则，请检查语法。: No rules parsed, check the syntax.
en.含远程 url()，应用后会发起网络请求。: Contains a remote url(), which makes a network request when applied.

en.提示：你覆盖的颜色可以直接用 var(--primary)、var(--back: Tip: your color overrides are available as var(--primary), var(--background) and so on.
en.整体放大或缩小界面，立即生效，按设备分别保存。⌘/Ctrl + 和 - 按与此菜: Scale the entire interface. Applies immediately and persists per device. ⌘/Ctrl + and - move through the same zoom levels as this menu (⌘/Ctrl 0 resets to 100%).
en.为界面、代码编辑器和终端分别选择字体。内置字体按需加载；选择“自定义…”可使用系: Choose fonts for the interface, code editor, and terminal. Bundled fonts load on demand; pick “Custom…” to use any font installed on your system.
en.终端连字仅对内置编程字体生效。: Terminal ligatures apply only to bundled coding fonts.
en.新会话页面输入框上方显示的「代码开发 / 日常办公」快捷卡片区域。: The Code Development / Office Work shortcut cards shown above the composer on the new conversation page.
en.在新会话页面显示: Show on the new conversation page
en.会话区域内的折叠/展开、工具调用、工作状态等动画，以及平滑滚动。关闭后界面立即更: Entrance, expand/collapse, tool-call and working-status animations in the conversation area, plus smooth scrolling. Turn off for instant, motion-free updates. Spinners keep rotating.
en.会话列与输入框的最大宽度。也可以直接拖动聊天区域左右两侧的边缘来调整。: Maximum width of the conversation column and the composer. You can also drag the edges of the chat column to adjust it.
en.数值按 100% 窗口缩放计，随缩放等比变化；过宽的值会按窗口大小自动限制。: Measured at 100% window zoom and scaled with it. Very wide values are limited to fit the window.
en.在整个工作区背后显示一张图片。侧栏与面板会变半透明并磨砂让图片透出，遮罩保证文字: Show a picture behind the whole workspace. Sidebar and panels turn translucent and frosted so the image shows through, and a mask keeps text readable.
en.支持 PNG、JPEG、WebP、GIF；动图会自动播放。: PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF. Animated images play automatically.
en.数值越高，图片越向主题背景色淡化，文字对比越清晰。: Higher values fade the image toward the theme background, improving text contrast.
en.侧栏、面板与标签栏的不透明程度。越低，透出的图片越多。: How opaque the sidebar, panels and tab bars are. Lower lets more of the image show through.
en.不支持的图片格式，请选择 PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 GIF。: Unsupported image format. Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF.
en.设置背景图片失败。: Failed to set the background image.
en.浏览 Wallhaven 公开图库，点击即可下载并应用。: Browse the public Wallhaven gallery; click to download and apply.
en.壁纸市场加载失败。: Failed to load the wallpaper market.

en.登录这台电脑后自动启动，无需每次手动打开。: Opens automatically after you sign in to this computer.
en.开启后，后续网络请求将优先走该代理（包括 ACP 对话、Agent 安装、Git: When enabled, subsequent network requests prefer this proxy (including ACP chat, agent installation and Git remote operations).
en.启用代理时必须填写代理地址: Proxy URL is required when proxy is enabled
en.设置应用语言。跟随系统时，若系统语言不受支持将回退为英文。: Set app language. When following system locale, unsupported languages fall back to English.
en.「配置同步」在设备之间搬运设置；「备份」打包这台设备上的全部 coaxi 数据。: Configuration sync carries your settings between machines; backup packs up all of this machine's coaxi data.
en.点击检查后会从配置的发布源拉取最新版本信息，有新版本时可直接下载并安装。: Check the configured release source for newer versions and install directly when available.
en.服务未能按时恢复，请检查容器或服务日志。: The server didn't come back in time. Check the container or service logs.
Waiting for the server to come back...
en.现在升级的是正在运行的容器。容器一旦被重建即丢失——如需保留，请拉取或构建新版本: This upgrades the running container now. It's lost if the container is recreated — to keep it, pull or build an image at the new version and recreate.
en.升级失败，服务器已自动回滚到上一版本。: Upgrade failed; the server rolled back to the previous version.
en.无法连接到服务器以开始升级。请确认服务器正在运行后重试。: Couldn't reach the server to start the upgrade. Check that it's running and try again.
en.恢复到上次升级前安装的版本。: Restore the version installed before the last upgrade.
en.回滚到上一个版本？: Roll back to the previous version?
en.服务器将重启并运行上次升级前安装的版本。更新的版本仍可再次安装。: The server will restart on the version installed before the last upgrade. A newer release stays available to install again.
en.已回滚到上一个版本，正在重新加载……: Rolled back to the previous version. Reloading...
en.回滚失败，请检查服务器日志。: Rollback failed. Check the server logs.
en.无法连接更新源，请检查网络或代理设置后重试。: Cannot reach the update source. Check your network or proxy and try again.
en.网络连接异常，请检查网络或代理设置后重试。: Network connection failed. Check your network or proxy and try again.
en.下载更新包失败，请稍后重试。: Failed to download update package. Please try again later.
en.安装更新失败，请关闭应用后重试。: Failed to install update. Please close the app and try again.
en.更新失败，请稍后重试。: Update failed. Please try again later.

en.输入服务器的密码或个人访问令牌。: Enter your password or a personal access token for the server.
en.点击右侧按钮后按下组合键即可修改。建议使用 Ctrl/Cmd、Alt、Shift: Click the right-side button, then press a key combination. Use Ctrl/Cmd, Alt, and Shift. Press Esc to cancel recording.

en.MCP 配置必须是 JSON 对象。: MCP config must be a JSON object.
en.MCP 配置缺少 type 字段。请填写 stdio、http（别名 strea: MCP config is missing the type field. Use one of stdio, http (aliases: streamable-http, streamableHttp), sse.
en.stdio 类型的 MCP 必须填写非空的 command 字段。: stdio MCP requires a non-empty command field.
en.远端 MCP 必须填写非空的 url 字段。: Remote MCP requires a non-empty url field.
en.请至少选择一个目标 App。: Select at least one target app.
en.请至少选择一个目标应用: Please select at least one target app
en.保存前请先修复或删除该文件并刷新：分配结果按本页能读到的智能体计算，现在保存可能: Fix or remove that file and refresh before saving: assignments are computed from the agents this page could read, so saving now could drop this server from one it could not.
en.本地 MCP 配置可直接编辑并保存。: Local MCP configuration can be edited and saved directly.
en.填写 Server ID 与配置以创建本地 MCP 服务器。: Provide a Server ID and configuration to create a local MCP server.
en.把表单填成 Google 官方的 chrome-devtools-mcp——re: Fills the form with Google’s official chrome-devtools-mcp — the registry lists lookalikes under the same name, so this pins the real one. It drives a SEPARATE Chrome that coaxi does not supervise: you get network and performance data the built-in browser tools do not offer, and none of their safeguards — no per-tab sharing, no activity strip, no approval per snippet. `npx` downloads the package from npm the first time it runs.
en.支持类型：stdio、http（别名 streamable-http、strea: Supported types: stdio, http (aliases: streamable-http, streamableHttp), sse. env is only used by stdio; for remote MCPs use headers to carry auth tokens.
en.检测到远端 MCP 配置中包含 env 字段。env 仅 stdio 类型使用，: env detected on a remote MCP. Only stdio uses env; remote MCPs carry auth tokens via headers, so env will be ignored on save.
en.安装配置(JSON，可修改后安装；修改后将覆盖协议/参数表单): Install Config (JSON, editable before install; edits will override protocol/parameter form)
en.请选择左侧市场 MCP 查看详情。: Select a marketplace MCP on the left to view details.
en.请选择左侧 MCP。: Select an MCP on the left.
en.统一管理 Agent 的连接SDK、启用状态、环境变量、配置管理与版本预检信息。: Manage Agent SDK connection, enabled state, environment variables, config management and version preflight info in one place.
en.由 Agent 自行处理文件与命令: Let the agent handle files and commands
en.coaxi 不再代为提供文件访问和终端命令，改由 Agent 在自己的进程中执行: coaxi stops serving file access and terminal commands, so the agent runs them in its own process — where its own sandbox and permission rules apply. Delegating to other agents is also turned off, since that would route the same work back through coaxi. coaxi adds no sandbox itself, so turn this on only if the agent has one configured.
en.留空则使用系统默认模型。: Leave empty to use system default model.
en.支持 API URL、API Key 与 Claude 模型快捷配置，并与原生: Supports quick configuration for API URL, API Key and Claude models, and syncs with native JSON config.
en.支持重要配置输入（API URL、API Key、Model）和原生 JSON: Supports important config input (API URL, API Key, Model) and native JSON config management.
en.允许活跃的智能体把子任务委托给其他智能体。: Allow active agents to delegate sub-tasks to other agents.
en.关闭后，delegate_to_agent 工具会从智能体的 MCP 工具清单中: When off, the delegate_to_agent tool is hidden from the agent's MCP catalog.
en.运行中委托会话已完成子智能体结果的内存缓存，仅在该会话运行期间保留，会话结束后自: In-memory cache of finished sub-agent results, held only while the delegating session is running and cleared automatically when it ends. Over this budget the oldest results are dropped from memory first (still viewable in the sub-agent's own session); 0 = unlimited (still cleared when the session ends).
en.多智能体协同在为委托调用启动子智能体时使用这些覆盖项。下方选项通过实时探测获取，: Per-agent overrides applied when Multi-Agent Collaboration spawns a subagent for a delegation call. Options shown here come from a live probe — what you pick is exactly what the agent will accept.
en.正在加载该智能体的可用配置项…: Loading available options from the agent…
en.该智能体没有可配置项。: This agent has no configurable options.
en.在此配置 Grok。下方控件——权限模式、推理强度、可选的自定义（自带端点）模型: Configure Grok here. The controls below — permission mode, reasoning effort, an optional custom (BYO endpoint) model, and compaction — merge into ~/.grok/config.toml, preserving your other keys and comments. Sign-in uses your XAI_API_KEY or `grok login`. Other keys stay editable under Advanced.
en.使用 xAI 控制台的 XAI_API_KEY 认证——适用于非交互/无头运行。: Authenticate with an XAI_API_KEY from the xAI console — for non-interactive or headless runs. Stored in this agent's environment.
en.使用自定义接口（BYO 端点）：在下方定义一个带有独立 base URL 和 A: Use a bring-your-own endpoint: define a custom model below with its own base URL and API key. It becomes Grok's default model.
en.使用 `grok login` 登录（SuperGrok / X Premium: Sign in with `grok login` (SuperGrok / X Premium+). No API key is stored.
en.在终端运行以下命令登录，然后重新打开此设置：: Run this in a terminal to sign in, then reopen these settings:
en.按原样整体写入 ~/.grok/config.toml。非法 TOML 会被拒绝: Saved verbatim as the whole ~/.grok/config.toml. Invalid TOML is rejected so a typo never truncates your file.
en.# 上面控件之外的键，例如\n# [mcp_servers.*]、[cli]、[:
# Keys other than the controls above, e.g.
# [mcp_servers.*], [cli], [permission] rules.
en.让 Grok 指向自定义或自托管端点。coaxi 会写入按模型的 `[model: Point Grok at a custom or self-hosted endpoint. coaxi writes a per-model `[model.*]` block and makes it the default. Leave the Model ID empty to remove it.
en.注册为 `[model.*]` 块，并作为模型名发送给 API；同时设为 `[m: Registered as a `[model.*]` block and sent to the API as the model name; also set as `[models].default`.
en.内联存储于 `[model.*].api_key`，仅作用于该端点。: Stored inline in `[model.*].api_key`, scoped to this endpoint.
en.可选。用于自动压缩计时；留空则使用端点默认值。: Optional. Drives auto-compact timing; leave empty for the endpoint default.
en.当上下文使用率达到该百分比时压缩对话（Grok 默认 85）。写入 `[sess: Compact the conversation when context usage reaches this percent (Grok default 85). Written to `[session]`.
en.在此配置 Cursor。先选择认证方式——官网订阅（浏览器登录）或用于无头/服务: Configure Cursor here. Choose an authentication method — official subscription (browser sign-in) or a Cursor API key for headless/server machines — then pick a model and edit the CLI's permission rules and sandbox. coaxi writes them into ~/.cursor/cli-config.json, shared with the cursor-agent CLI.
en.cursor-agent 里仍存有登录凭据，但刚才无法用它访问 Cursor——: cursor-agent still has a login stored, but it could not be used against Cursor just now — usually an expired session. Sessions will fail with "Authentication required" until you sign in again; the CLI has no way to refresh a browser login on its own.
en.cursor-agent 里存了 API Key，但 Cursor 刚刚拒绝了它: cursor-agent has an API key stored, but Cursor rejected it just now — usually a revoked, expired, or mistyped key. Sessions will fail with "Authentication required" until you save a working key below.
en.在终端运行以下命令登录 Cursor 账号（会打开浏览器），完成后点刷新：: Run this in a terminal to sign in with your Cursor account (a browser window opens), then hit refresh:
en.请在安装了 cursor-agent 的 coaxi 主机上运行，而不是本机，完: Run this on the coaxi host where cursor-agent is installed, not on this machine, then hit refresh. That host usually has no browser to open, so run it with NO_OPEN_BROWSER=1 — it prints a sign-in URL for you to open in your own browser instead. For an unattended server, switch the method above to API key.
en.CURSOR_API_KEY —— Cursor Dashboard 的账号密钥: CURSOR_API_KEY — a Cursor Dashboard account key, an alternative to browser login for headless/server machines. Not a third-party or OpenAI key.
en.会话启动时通过 --model 传给 CLI；保持默认则由 Cursor 自行选: Passed to the CLI as --model at session start. Leave on default to let Cursor choose.
en.Cursor 把每种组合都当作独立的模型 ID，这几个控件负责挑出对应的那一个。: Cursor ships every combination as its own model id; these controls pick the right one. They set the launch default — a session can change model, thinking and Fast at any time from the composer.
en.可视化编辑 CLI 权限规则（cli-config.json）。允许规则免确认执: Visual editor for the CLI's permission rules (cli-config.json). Allow rules run without prompting; deny rules are always blocked.
en.Run Everything 以 --force 启动会话：除 deny 规则外: Run Everything launches sessions with --force: every tool call is auto-allowed except deny rules, with no confirmation prompts (an organization policy may downgrade it to allow-rule matching). Takes effect for new sessions.
en.「运行前询问」会把每次工具调用交给你确认，其中带有 Cursor 自己的「始终允: Ask before running sends each tool call to you for approval, with Cursor's own "Allow always" option — choosing it appends a rule to the Allowed list below, so the same call runs unprompted next time.
en.规则语法：Shell(命令)、Read(路径/通配)、Write(路径/通配)、: Rule syntax: Shell(cmd), Read(path/glob), Write(path/glob), WebFetch(domain), Mcp(server:tool) — deny rules always win.
en.完整的 ~/.cursor/cli-config.json。此处保存按原文写入；: The whole ~/.cursor/cli-config.json. Saving writes the file verbatim — the structured controls above merge into it instead.
en.使用 Cursor 账号登录，使用 Cursor 的模型。: Sign in with your Cursor account and use Cursor's models.
en.需要填写 Cursor API 密钥。: A Cursor API key is required.
en.用 Cursor 官网 Dashboard 生成的账号 API 密钥认证（适用于: Authenticate with a Cursor account API key from the Cursor dashboard — for headless or server machines. This is a Cursor account key, not a third-party/OpenAI endpoint: cursor-agent only talks to Cursor's own backend. To use a codex/OpenAI-compatible endpoint, use the Codex agent instead.
en.登录后加载模型列表。: Sign in to load the model list.
en.在此登录 Qoder 账号。CLI 读取的其余配置全部集中在一个文件里——$QO: Sign in to Qoder here. Everything else the CLI reads lives in one file — $QODER_CONFIG_DIR/settings.json (default ~/.qoder), shared with the qoder CLI — and is edited raw below. Model and reasoning effort are not here: Qoder reports them over ACP, so the composer's own selectors own them per session.
en.在终端运行以下命令登录 Qoder 账号（会打开浏览器），完成后点刷新：: Run this in a terminal to sign in with your Qoder account (a browser window opens), then hit refresh:
en.QODER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN —— 浏览器登录跑不起来: QODER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN — a non-interactive credential for machines where the browser sign-in can't run. Leave empty to use the qoder account login.
en.完整的 settings.json，保存时按原文写入——这也是唯一能删除某个键的: The whole settings.json, written verbatim on save — which is also the only way to delete a key.
en.Antigravity 必须先选定认证方式才能开始会话。所选方式会写入 $GEM: Antigravity needs an authentication method before it can start a session. The choice is written to auth.type in $GEMINI_HOME/antigravity-acp/settings.json, which is the only place the ACP server looks — without it every new session fails with "Authentication required". Model and session mode are not here: Antigravity reports them over ACP, so the composer's own selectors own them per session.
en.你的 Google 账号，任意 Antigravity 套餐（含免费版）均可。首: Your Google account, on any Antigravity plan including the free tier. The first new session opens a browser to finish signing in; the token is then cached and reused. No browser on this machine? Use the browser-free sign-in below.
en.你的 Gemini Enterprise 账号。需要填 GCP 项目与区域，首次: Your Gemini Enterprise account. Needs a GCP project and location, and the first new session opens a browser. No browser on this machine? Use the browser-free sign-in below.
en.Gemini Developer API 的密钥，以 GEMINI_API_KE: A key for the Gemini Developer API, passed to the agent as GEMINI_API_KEY.
en.即原 Vertex AI。可用 API Key，或用项目 + 区域配合应用默认凭: Formerly Vertex AI. Use an API key, or a project and location with Application Default Credentials (gcloud auth application-default login).
en.可选。填了就单独使用它，下面的项目与区域会被忽略；留空则改用应用默认凭据认证。: Optional. When set it is used on its own — the project and location below are ignored. Leave it empty to authenticate with Application Default Credentials instead.
en.请填写 Gemini API Key，或改用其他认证方式 —— 否则会话无法启动: Enter a Gemini API key, or pick a different authentication method — sessions will fail to start without it.
en.请填写 API Key，或同时填写项目与区域 —— 二者缺一不可，否则会话无法启: Enter an API key, or both a project and a location — sessions will fail to start without one of the two.
en.Gemini Enterprise 需要同时填写项目与区域。: Gemini Enterprise needs both a project and a location.
en.auth.type 会保存到该文件；你自己写在里面的其他键会原样保留。: Saved to auth.type in this file. Any other keys you put there are preserved.
en.你的选择已经存下来了，但 coaxi 没能写进 ACP 服务端的 setting: Your choice was saved, but coaxi could not write it to the ACP server's settings.json, so Antigravity will keep authenticating the way that file says. Set auth.type in it yourself, or move it aside and save again.
en.在没有浏览器的机器上登录: Sign in without a browser on this machine
en.Antigravity 的 Google 登录由智能体自己发起，浏览器必须开在运: Antigravity runs the Google sign-in itself, on the machine the agent runs on. When there is no browser there — coaxi on a server with no desktop — the first session waits five minutes and then fails. Start the sign-in here instead: open the link on any device, then paste back the address you land on.
en.请先保存——登录用的是已保存的设置，而不是上面刚填的内容。: Save first — the sign-in uses the stored settings, not what is typed above.
en.1. 打开这个链接并登录 Google 账号。: 1. Open this link and sign in to Google.
en.已登录，新会话将使用该账号。: Signed in. New sessions will use this account.
en.Antigravity 本来就持有有效令牌，无需链接即已登录。: Antigravity already had a valid token, so it signed in without a link.
en.令牌缓存在这里。把这个文件复制到其他无桌面机器，那台也就登录好了。: The token is cached here. Copy this file to another machine with no desktop to sign that one in too.
en.登录了错误的账号？: Signed in as the wrong account?
en.Antigravity 会缓存登录时使用的 Google 账号并静默复用，所以再: Antigravity caches the Google account it signed in as and reuses it silently, so signing in again cannot reach a different one. Signing out discards the stored credential; any running Antigravity sessions end first, because they would otherwise write the old account back.
en.已退出登录。重新登录即可选择其他账号。: Signed out. Sign in again to pick a different account.
en.旧版本 coaxi 无法清理该代理每次启动时解压的临时目录。此操作会扫描系统临时: Older versions of coaxi could not clean up the temporary directory this agent unpacks on every launch. This scans the system temp folder for those leftovers. That folder is shared with other applications, so nothing is deleted until you confirm, and anything still in use is skipped.
en.端点与密钥是 deepseek-acp 启动时读取的环境变量。模型和推理档位是会: The endpoint and key are environment variables deepseek-acp reads at launch. Model and reasoning effort are per-session selectors — pick them in the composer.
en.留空则使用官方端点。保存后对新建的会话生效——正在进行的会话需要重新连接才会切换: Leave empty for the official endpoint. Applies to sessions started after the save — reconnect a running session to pick it up.
Enter a full http(s) URL with no query string, for example https://api.deepseek.com
en.以 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 传给智能体。环境变量的优先级高于凭据文件，: Passed to the agent as DEEPSEEK_API_KEY. An environment variable outranks the credentials file, so leave this empty if you sign in through the terminal.
en.支持 API URL、API Key、模型名称快捷配置，并与 `auth.jso: Supports quick configuration for API URL, API Key and model name, and syncs with `auth.json` / `config.toml`.
en.使用 ChatGPT 官网订阅登录，无需配置 API Key: Log in with ChatGPT official subscription, no API Key required
en.使用 API Key 连接 OpenAI 或兼容的 API 服务: Connect using API Key to OpenAI or compatible API services
en.允许 Codex 在默认模式下提问: Allow Codex to ask questions in Default mode
en.Codex 的 request_user_input 工具默认只在 Plan 模: Codex may only call its request_user_input tool in Plan mode. Turn this on to let it ask you questions in ordinary turns too. Writes [features].default_mode_request_user_input to ~/.codex/config.toml; the flag is still under development upstream. Takes effect on the next session.
en.Codex 启用 Fast 服务等级: Enable Fast service tier for Codex
en.写入全局 ~/.codex/config.toml，codex CLI 与 ID: Written to the global ~/.codex/config.toml, so codex CLI and IDE sessions see it too. These are thread defaults: they govern the turns codex starts on its own (/goal, /review, /compact). Ordinary prompts use the composer's approval preset instead. Restart a session to pick up changes.
en.config.toml 里设置了 default_permissions，cod: config.toml sets default_permissions, so codex resolves permissions through that profile and ignores sandbox_mode entirely. Remove default_permissions to use the controls below.
en.config.toml 定义了 [permissions] 配置档却没有 def: config.toml defines [permissions] profiles but no default_permissions, which makes codex refuse to start. Set one in the raw editor below.
en.按需询问 — 由模型决定何时请求批准: On request — the model decides when to ask
en.仅信任只读 — 只有已知安全的只读命令免批准: Untrusted — only known-safe read-only commands run unattended
en.从不询问 — 完全不弹审批: Never — no approval prompts at all
en.ACP 适配器只有三种审批预设，untrusted 无对应项，coaxi 会话会: Untrusted has no equivalent in the ACP adapter's three approval presets, so coaxi sessions fall back to "on request" — the model then decides when to ask, and commands the sandbox already allows stop prompting. Tighten the sandbox mode below instead.
en.关闭表示该类请求被自动拒绝，而不是弹给你确认。: Off means requests of that kind are auto-rejected instead of shown to you.
en.未设置（受信任的文件夹回落为可写工作区）: Not set (trusted folders fall back to workspace write)
en.codex-acp 1.7–1.13 没有只读沙箱：在这些适配器版本上，无论这里: codex-acp 1.7–1.13 ship no read-only sandbox: on those adapter versions a coaxi session runs workspace-writable whatever this says, with every escalation still coming to you. codex-acp 2.0 restored it, so update the adapter if an older one is installed. codex CLI and IDE sessions always honor read-only.
en.在 Windows 上，未开启 codex 的实验性 Windows 沙箱时，可: On Windows, workspace write is downgraded to read-only unless codex's experimental Windows sandbox is enabled.
en.coaxi 还会用它推导会话的初始审批预设，因此与审批策略不同，它对普通提问同样: coaxi also maps this onto the session's starting approval preset, so unlike approval policy it does reach ordinary prompts. read-only starts in "Read-only". With approval policy never, danger-full-access starts in "Full access" and workspace-write in "Auto review", where a model pre-screens escalations and forwards only what it judges unsafe. With any other approval policy, workspace-write and danger-full-access start in "Workspace access", which brings every escalation to you, on codex-acp 2.0 and later, and in "Auto review" on older adapters. Unset leaves the adapter's default, "Auto review". The composer's preset always overrides this.
en.每行一个绝对路径，作为工作目录之外的额外可写位置。: One absolute path per line, in addition to the working directory.
en.在浏览器中打开以下链接：: Open the following URL in your browser:
en.登录超时，请重试: Login timed out, please try again
en.登录成功但配置保存失败: Login succeeded but failed to save config
en.对齐 Gemini CLI 认证文档，支持自定义、Google 登录、Gemin: Aligned with Gemini CLI authentication docs, supporting custom endpoint, Google login, Gemini API Key and Vertex AI (ADC / service account / API Key).
en.填写 API URL、API Key 和 Model，分别映射到 GOOGLE_: Fill API URL, API Key and Model, mapped to GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL / GEMINI_API_KEY / GEMINI_MODEL.
en.首次在终端运行 gemini 并完成 Google 登录；无需填写 API Ke: Run gemini in terminal and complete Google login first; API key is not required.
en.使用 Gemini API 时填写 GEMINI_API_KEY。: Fill GEMINI_API_KEY when using Gemini API.
en.使用 gcloud ADC，建议填写 GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT: Use gcloud ADC; GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT and GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION are recommended.
en.服务账号 JSON 路径写入 GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDEN: Set service account JSON path to GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.
en.使用 Vertex AI API key 时填写 GOOGLE_API_KEY。: Fill GOOGLE_API_KEY when using Vertex AI API key.
en.对齐 OpenCode `provider` 配置结构，支持多供应商管理，并与原: Aligned with OpenCode `provider` schema, supports multi-provider management and two-way sync with native JSON files.
en.还没有自定义 Provider。点击「添加自定义 Provider」创建。: No custom providers yet. Click Add custom provider to create one.
en.对齐 OpenCode `provider.models` 结构。当前支持 `n: Aligned with OpenCode `provider.models`. Fast management currently supports `name` / `id`; other advanced fields are preserved and can be edited in native JSON below.
en.暂无模型，输入 model id 后点击“添加模型”创建。: No model yet. Enter model id then click "Add model".
en.你自己定义的 OpenAI 兼容端点——opencode.json 里的一个 p: OpenAI-compatible endpoints you define yourself — a provider block in opencode.json, with the API key in auth.json.
en.从 models.dev 目录选择一个 Provider。凭证保存到 OpenC: Choose a provider from the models.dev catalog. Credentials are saved to the OpenCode auth.json file.
en.该 Provider 也支持通过 opencode auth login 浏览器: This provider also supports browser sign-in via opencode auth login. Browser sign-in is coming soon — for now, paste an API key.
en.保存在 auth.json，绝不写入 opencode.json。: Stored in auth.json, never in opencode.json.
en.更新该 Provider 的 API Key 或 Base URL。: Update this provider's API key or base URL.
en.定义一个 OpenAI 兼容端点。API key 保存到 auth.json；p: Define an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The API key is saved to auth.json; the provider block goes to opencode.json.
en.决定哪些操作直接运行、先征求你的同意，还是被阻止。写入 opencode.jso: Decide which actions run on their own, prompt you first, or are blocked. Written to the permission block of opencode.json and applied once you save below.
en.下方的原生 JSON 当前无法解析，可视化编辑已暂停。修复 JSON 后即可继续: The native JSON below is not valid, so the visual editor is paused. Fix the JSON to resume.
en.permission 配置的结构无法识别。请在下方原生 JSON 中修改，或点击: The permission block has a shape coaxi does not recognize. Edit it in the native JSON below, or use Reset to start over.
en.通配规则写在了具体工具之后，OpenCode 会把它一并应用到这些工具上——下方: A wildcard rule is written after specific tools, so OpenCode applies it to them as well — the rows below are not what is in force. Fix order moves every wildcard back to the front of its scope without changing a single value.
en.有规则被后面更宽泛的模式遮蔽，OpenCode 永远不会应用它——下方各行显示的: One rule is shadowed by a later, more general pattern, so OpenCode never applies it — the rows below are not what is in force. Two overlapping patterns have no single right order; reorder them in the native JSON so the general one comes first.
en.顶层的旧版 tools 配置禁用了某个工具。OpenCode 会把它并入权限，因: The legacy top-level tools map denies a tool. OpenCode folds it into the permissions, so it applies on top of everything shown here. Edit it in the native JSON below, or turn on auto-accept to clear it.
en.所有工具调用（shell 命令、文件修改、访问项目外路径）都不再询问，直接执行。: Every tool call — shell commands, file edits, paths outside the project — runs without asking. Turning this on replaces the per-tool settings below with a single allow-all rule, and clears the per-agent permission overrides and legacy tool toggles that would otherwise still block.
en.即 * 规则：下方工具未单独覆盖时采用的动作。: The * rule: what applies to anything the tools below do not override.
en.按工具输入匹配，最后匹配的规则优先，因此请把宽泛的模式写在前面。* 匹配任意多个: Matched against the tool input, last match wins — so put the broad patterns first. * matches any characters, ? matches exactly one, and a leading ~ expands to your home directory.
en.规则必须有模式；如需删除请点击垃圾桶图标。: A rule needs a pattern — use the trash icon to remove it.
en.文件中的其他权限键: Other permission keys in the file
en.并非 OpenCode 内置工具，将按原样保留。: Not a built-in OpenCode tool — kept as written.
en.运行 shell 命令，按解析后的命令匹配: Run shell commands, matched by the parsed command
en.所有文件修改：edit、write 与 patch: All file modifications: edit, write and patch
en.访问项目工作目录之外的路径: Reach paths outside the project working directory
en.启动子代理，按子代理类型匹配: Launch subagents, matched by subagent type
en.加载技能，按技能名称匹配: Load skills, matched by skill name
en.查找文件，按通配模式匹配: Find files, matched by glob pattern
en.搜索文件内容，按模式匹配: Search file contents, matched by pattern
en.同一调用以相同输入重复 3 次时触发: Trips when the same call repeats three times with identical input
en.会话默认值、上下文压缩与工具输出上限。写入 opencode.json，点击下方: Session defaults, context compaction and tool-output limits. Written to opencode.json and applied once you save below.
en.新会话使用哪个主智能体。留空或填了无效名称时回落到 build。: Which primary agent a new session opens in. Falls back to build when empty or unknown.
en.会话是否可以发布成分享链接。: How a session may be published to a share link.
en.OpenCode 是否自行升级到最新版本。: Whether OpenCode updates itself to the latest release.
en.每一步之前记录一次快照。关闭后撤销与回滚将无法还原文件。: Records a snapshot before each step. Turning it off means undo and revert can no longer restore files.
en.上下文窗口快满时自动总结会话。: Summarize the conversation automatically when the context window fills up.
en.压缩时直接丢弃较早工具调用的输出，而不是把它们总结进去。: Drop the output of older tool calls during compaction instead of summarizing it.
en.子智能体最多可以嵌套几层。填 1 表示子智能体不能再启动子智能体。: How deep sub-agents may nest. 1 stops a sub-agent from launching another.
en.最近多少轮用户对话不参与压缩。留空表示只受下面的 token 预算约束。: Most recent user turns kept uncompacted. Unset means only the token budget below limits them.
en.压缩后仍按原文保留的最近对话 token 预算。: Token budget of recent turns kept uncompacted after a compaction.
en.为压缩本身预留的窗口，避免压缩过程反而撑爆上下文。: Window left free so a compaction itself never overflows the context.
en.超过该行数的输出会落盘，只在会话里留一段预览。默认 2000。: Output longer than this is written to disk and replaced with a preview. Default 2000.
en.超过该字节数的输出会落盘，只在会话里留一段预览。默认 51200。: Output larger than this is written to disk and replaced with a preview. Default 51200.
en.配置 OpenClaw Gateway 连接信息。支持本地或远程 Gateway: Configure OpenClaw Gateway connection. Supports local or remote gateway.
en.留空则使用 openclaw 本地配置的 gateway.remote.url。: Leave empty to use gateway.remote.url from local openclaw config.
en.建议使用 token-file 替代明文 Token，可通过 openclaw: Use token-file instead of plain token when possible; configure via openclaw CLI.
en.可选。指定 Gateway Session Key，留空则自动分配隔离会话。: Optional. Specify gateway session key; leave empty to auto-assign isolated session.
en.Hermes 在 ~/.hermes/.env 中管理自己的凭据，在 ~/.he: Hermes manages its own credentials in ~/.hermes/.env and settings in ~/.hermes/config.yaml. Pick a provider, then set the API key and model — coaxi writes both files for you.
en.供应商决定 Hermes 使用哪个 API 密钥变量和 model.provid: The provider selects which API key variable and model.provider Hermes uses. OAuth providers are configured through the terminal setup below.
en.保存到 ~/.hermes/.env。它绝不会被注入进程——Hermes 会从自: Saved to ~/.hermes/.env. It is never injected into the process — Hermes reads it from its own config.
en.此供应商使用 OAuth。请运行下方的设置流程，在终端中完成认证。: This provider uses OAuth. Run the setup below to authenticate in your terminal.
en.Bedrock 使用你的 AWS 凭据（环境变量或共享配置）。请在上方填写模型: Bedrock uses your AWS credentials (environment or shared config). Set the model id above and configure AWS access in your environment.
en.该提供商无法通过结构化字段编辑。请使用下方的 config.yaml 原始编辑器: This provider isn't editable with structured fields. Use the raw config.yaml editor below or the terminal setup.
en.Hermes 的交互式设置需要终端。可在下方启动，或复制命令自行运行。: Hermes's interactive setup needs a terminal. Launch it below, or copy the command to run it yourself.
en.直接编辑 ~/.hermes/config.yaml。在此保存将原样覆盖该文件。: Edit ~/.hermes/config.yaml directly. Saving here overwrites the file verbatim.
en.CodeBuddy 使用 API Key 进行认证。中国版还必须将环境设为“中国: CodeBuddy authenticates with an API key. Mainland China builds also require the environment set to “China (internal)”; iOA builds use “iOA”. The overseas build leaves it unset.
en.将作为该智能体的 CODEBUDDY_API_KEY 保存。也可以在终端用 Co: Saved as CODEBUDDY_API_KEY for this agent. Alternatively, sign in with the CodeBuddy CLI in a terminal.
en.将作为该智能体的 CODEBUDDY_API_KEY 保存。请使用你的私有化部署: Saved as CODEBUDDY_API_KEY for this agent. Use the key issued by your private deployment.
en.设置 CODEBUDDY_INTERNET_ENVIRONMENT。中国大陆必须: Sets CODEBUDDY_INTERNET_ENVIRONMENT. Mainland China must use “China (internal)”; the overseas build leaves it unset.
en.保存为 CODEBUDDY_BASE_URL，将 CodeBuddy 指向你的私: Saved as CODEBUDDY_BASE_URL and points CodeBuddy at your private endpoint. The region setting is left unset for self-hosted deployments.
en.没有 API Key？也可以在终端运行 “codebuddy” 用腾讯云账号登录: No API key? Run “codebuddy” in a terminal to sign in with your Tencent account instead.
en.`kimi acp` 只认已存储的登录令牌，所以 coaxi 会在 ~/.kim: `kimi acp` only accepts a stored login token, so coaxi writes a managed provider into ~/.kimi-code/config.toml and seeds a local gate token — inference still runs on your own key.
en.已通过 Kimi 账号登录: Signed in with a Kimi account
en.在 config.toml 写入受管供应商，并播种门控令牌以便会话能够打开。: Writes a coaxi-managed provider into config.toml and seeds the gate token so sessions can open.
Run `kimi login` in a terminal to sign in with a Kimi subscription account — on Kimi 0.39.0+ add `--region global` for a kimi.ai account, since the default signs in to kimi.com. coaxi stores nothing and reuses Kimi's own login. Saving here removes coaxi's API-key gate token.
en.Kimi 使用的供应商协议（config.toml 的 `type`）。Moon: The provider protocol Kimi speaks (config.toml `type`). Use Kimi / Moonshot for a Moonshot / platform.kimi.com key.
en.国际 = api.moonshot.ai；中国（platform.kimi.co: International = api.moonshot.ai; China (platform.kimi.com keys) = api.moonshot.cn. Custom points at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
en.留空则使用供应商 SDK 默认值。: Leave blank to use the provider SDK default.
en.写入 ~/.kimi-code/config.toml 并用于推理。来自 pla: Written to ~/.kimi-code/config.toml and used for inference. From platform.kimi.com or platform.kimi.ai.
en.Vertex AI 使用 Google 应用默认凭据——运行 `gcloud a: Vertex AI uses Google Application Default Credentials — run `gcloud auth application-default login` (no API key).
en.写入 config.toml 的模型 id。点「测试并获取模型」可查看你的 Ke: The model id written to config.toml. Use “Test & list models” to see what your key can actually access.
en.Kimi 的配置 schema 要求必填：缺失会让 Kimi 丢弃整个模型块，导: Required by Kimi's schema: without it Kimi discards the whole model block and every prompt comes back empty. Defaults to 262144.
en.Key 可用，但未返回任何模型: Key works, but no models were returned
en.请先填写 API Key 和接入点: Enter an API key and endpoint first
en.该模型不在你的 Key 可访问列表中，Kimi 会报「模型不存在」。: This model is not in the list your key can access — Kimi will fail with “model not found”.
en.只有当模型声明了推理能力，Kimi 才会在输入框显示「Thinking」选择器，: Kimi only shows a Thinking picker in the composer when the model declares a reasoning capability, so coaxi writes one here. Takes effect on new sessions.
en.这些会成为输入框「Thinking」选择器里的档位。Kimi 会把档位原样透传给: These become the rows of the composer's Thinking picker. Kimi forwards the level to the provider verbatim, so pick ones your model accepts.
en.一个档位都不选时，输入框只会退化成 Off / On 两档开关。: With no levels chosen the composer falls back to a plain Off / On toggle.
en.模型始终推理——从选择器中去掉 Off 档: The model always reasons — remove the Off row from the picker
en.API Key 不能包含换行: The API key must not contain line breaks
en.必须以 http:// 或 https:// 开头: Must start with http:// or https://
en.必须是上面已选中的档位之一: Pick one of the levels selected above
en.API Key 在 config.toml 中的写入位置。: Where the API key is written inside config.toml.
en.在此保存会按原文覆盖整个文件，替换掉上方的结构化配置。: Saving here overwrites the entire file verbatim, replacing the structured settings above.
en.手动配置 API URL 和 API Key 连接自定义接口。: Manually configure API URL and API Key for a custom endpoint.
en.使用已配置的模型供应商的 API URL、API Key 和模型。: Use API URL, API Key, and model from a configured model provider.
en.该代理未配置模型供应商。请前往模型供应商设置添加。: No model provider configured for this agent. Go to Model Provider Settings to add one.
en.使用 Anthropic 官方订阅，无需 API Key。: Use official Anthropic subscription, no API Key required.
en.在 Claude 模型选择器中追加一个自定义条目（例如经自定义网关/代理提供的模: Adds a single custom entry to Claude's model picker (e.g. a model behind a custom gateway/proxy). Name and description are optional display overrides.
en.向接口发送归属/计费标识: Send attribution/billing identifier to the API
en.向接口发送 Claude Code 归属/计费标识: Send Claude Code attribution/billing identifier to the API

en.禁用 Claude Code 遥测或多余的网络请求: Disable Claude Code telemetry or redundant network requests

en.请输入有效的版本号，例如 1.2.3。: Enter a valid version number, e.g. 1.2.3.
en.原生 JSON 配置必须是对象: Native JSON config must be an object
en.OpenCode auth.json 必须是 JSON 对象: OpenCode auth.json must be a JSON object
en.auth.json 必须是 JSON 对象: auth.json must be a JSON object

en.Pi 通过模型提供方的 API Key 鉴权。Key 写入 ~/.pi/agen: Pi authenticates with your model provider's API key. The key is written to ~/.pi/agent/auth.json and the model selection to settings.json.
en.为所选提供方写入 ~/.pi/agent/auth.json。: Stored in ~/.pi/agent/auth.json for the selected provider.
en.选择运行哪个 pi。使用默认，或指向你自己的 pi 构建。: Choose which pi binary runs. Use the default, or point at your own pi build.
en.使用内置 pi-acp 适配器拉起 PATH 上的 pi。 安装 pi：npm: Use the bundled pi-acp adapter with the pi on your PATH. Install pi with: npm install -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent
en.运行你自己的 pi 构建、安装或包装脚本。: Run your own pi build, install, or wrapper.
en.请使用绝对路径或 PATH 中的命令名。: Use an absolute path or a command name on PATH.
en.请使用 Pi 命令的绝对路径或 PATH 中的命令名。: Use an absolute Pi command path or a command name on PATH.
en.请使用 Pi agent 目录的绝对路径或 ~/...；相对目录会因工作区不同而: Use an absolute Pi agent directory or ~/...; relative directories differ between workspaces.
en.pi-acp 不转发自定义 pi 参数（--approve、-e 等）——用脚本: Custom pi flags (--approve, -e, …) aren't forwarded by pi-acp — wrap pi in a script and point the command at it.
en.请输入 pi 命令以保存: Enter a pi command to save
en.在 ~/.pi/agent/models.json 中按你的接口地址定义一个提供: Defines a provider in ~/.pi/agent/models.json at your endpoint. Most self-hosted or proxy servers use openai-completions.
en.pi-acp 运行此 pi 二进制。可在此安装，或在下方指向你自己的构建。: pi-acp runs this pi binary. Install it here, or point pi-acp at your own build below.
en.设置了自定义配置目录后，设置页中管理的技能、专家与办公工具将不会作用于该 pi；: With a custom config directory, the Skills, Experts, and Office tools managed in Settings won't apply to this pi — manage its skills in that folder directly.
en.这两个目录只对 pi 进程生效。coaxi 的历史会话列表读取的是 pi 的默认: These directories reach the pi process only. coaxi's conversation history reads pi's own default location, so sessions written to a custom directory here won't be listed.
en.你允许 pi 从中加载项目文件的目录。被信任的目录会让该仓库的 .pi/exte: Folders you allowed pi to load project files from. A trusted folder lets that repository's .pi/extensions run code when pi starts, applies to every folder inside it, and is also used when you run pi in a terminal.
en.只有模型声明了推理能力，pi 才会发送推理强度——未声明的模型所有档位都会被压回: pi only sends a reasoning effort for a model that declares it — an undeclared model has every level clamped to Off, so the composer's picker springs back the moment you touch it. Written to this model's entry in models.json.
en.这些会成为输入框推理选择器里的档位。请选你的接入点能接受的值；不在这里的档位 p: These become the rows in the composer's reasoning picker. Pick the ones your endpoint accepts; pi rejects any level that isn't listed here.
en.至少选一个档位——一个都不选时 pi 只会退回 Off。: Pick at least one level — with none, pi falls back to Off.
en.高级：发给供应商的值: Advanced: values sent to the provider
en.留空表示原样发送档位名。接入点需要别的写法时才填——Google 系需要 LOW: Leave blank to send the level name as-is. Set one when your endpoint expects something else — Google-style backends want LOW / HIGH.
en.该档位不在上面的可选列表里——pi 会把它压下来。: This level isn't in the available list above — pi would clamp it.
en.Pi 没有在该提供方下列出此模型。请检查模型 ID——Pi 只列出已配置 API: Pi doesn't list this model for this provider. Check the model ID — Pi only lists providers it has an API key or login for.
en.无法向 Pi 查询此模型提供哪些思考档位。: Couldn't ask Pi which thinking levels this model offers.
en.接入任意兼容 ACP 的智能体。可从公开 ACP 注册表中选择，或直接粘贴其注册: Register any ACP-compatible agent. Pick one from the public ACP registry, or paste its registry information.
en.当前平台没有可用的构建: No build available for this platform
en.未找到 npx、uvx 或 binary 分发方式: No npx, uvx, or binary distribution found
en.修改名称、图标、分发信息与技能声明；智能体 ID 不可修改。: Update the name, icon, distribution and skills declarations. The agent ID cannot be changed.
en.查询本地安装版本的命令；留空时默认执行智能体命令加 --version。: Command that prints the locally installed version. Left empty, coaxi runs the agent command with --version.
en.删除该智能体定义。已有会话的历史会保留，只是该智能体无法再启动。: Deletes the agent definition. Existing conversations keep their history; the agent just can no longer be launched.
en.随智能体一起保存，离线也能显示。不上传则使用彩色首字母。: Stored with the agent, so it works offline. Without one, a colored initial is used.
en.声明该智能体会读取共享的 .agents/skills 目录（全局与项目级），并: Declares that this agent reads the shared .agents/skills store — its global and project directories — and adds it to every skills matrix. Skills linked there are visible to every agent that reads the shared store.
en.该智能体自身加载技能的目录绝对路径 —— 可与共享目录并存，也可单独使用。~ 会: Absolute path of a directory this agent loads skills from — its own store, in addition to (or instead of) the shared one. ~ expands to your home directory; linked skills are placed here first.
en.会话建立时向该智能体注入 coaxi 内置的 coaxi-mcp 伴生进程 ——: Sends coaxi's built-in MCP companion to this agent when a session starts — the channel behind delegation, live feedback and task tools. Turn it off for an agent that rejects MCP servers and fails to connect; the change applies to the next connection.
en.同时删除已记录的会话历史: Also delete its recorded conversation history
en.直接读写文件、执行命令完成任务: Reads and edits files and runs commands directly to get the job done
en.先调研再给出完整方案，经你确认后才动手；这只是对模型的引导，实际边界仍由「文件权: Investigates first and proposes a full plan for you to confirm before touching anything. This steers the model — the real boundary is still whatever File access allows.
en.越高越慢越费 token，难题更稳: Higher is slower and costs more tokens, but steadier on hard problems
en.命令与文件工具共用这一条边界: Commands and file tools share this one boundary
en.不做推理，直接作答；最快: Answers directly with no reasoning; fastest
en.略作推理；比关闭稳，比高档快: Reasons briefly; steadier than off, faster than high
en.推理后作答；日常编码的默认档: Reasons before answering; the everyday coding default
en.推理更久；难题更稳，但慢且更费 token: Reasons longer; steadier on hard problems, but slower and costs more tokens
en.按只读策略执行；需要写入时切换权限。部分平台上只是部分强制。: Runs under a read-only policy; switch access when a write is needed. Enforcement can be partial on some platforms.
en.写入意在限制于会话工作区与系统临时目录；越界的调用会请求单次授权。部分平台上只是: Writes are meant to stay inside the session workspace and the system temp directories; a call outside them asks for one-time approval. Enforcement can be partial on some platforms.
en.不施加任何文件限制。仅在你清楚后果时选择。: Applies no file restrictions at all. Choose it only when you understand the consequences.
en.选择点击主窗口关闭按钮时的行为。: Choose what the main window's close button does.
en.当前系统没有可用的托盘，关闭按钮将始终退出 coaxi。: This system has no usable tray, so the close button always exits coaxi.
en.coaxi 可以最小化到托盘继续运行，智能体和终端保持活动；也可以完全退出。: coaxi can keep running in the tray so agents and terminals stay alive, or exit completely.
en.当前设置为：关闭窗口即退出 coaxi。: Closing the window is set to exit coaxi.
en.集中管理默认终端、渲染加速、关闭行为、通知与提示音等通用偏好。: Centralized preferences for the default terminal, rendering acceleration, window close behavior, notifications and sounds.
en.选择 coaxi 打开新终端标签页、以及代智能体执行整条命令行时使用的 Shel: Choose the shell coaxi launches for new terminal tabs and for whole command lines an agent asks coaxi to run. Agents with a shell of their own (Codex, Claude Code) run commands inside their own process, where this setting cannot reach them.
en.支持绝对路径，或 PATH 中可解析的命令名。: Provide an absolute path or a name resolvable on PATH.
en.当前主机上不存在此路径。: This path doesn't exist on this host.
en.强制智能体运行的命令输出 ANSI 颜色，使其在会话记录中以彩色而非纯文本呈现。: Force ANSI color out of the commands agents run, so their output renders in color in the transcript instead of as plain text. Takes effect on new sessions.
en.如果应用出现黑屏或渲染异常（Windows 上常见于 AMD 显卡或部分 Int: Disable hardware acceleration if the app shows a black screen or rendering glitches (common on certain AMD GPUs or Intel integrated GPUs on Windows, and with the proprietary NVIDIA driver on Linux). Only takes effect on the Windows and Linux desktop builds.
en.已保存，重启应用后生效。: Saved. Restart the app for the change to take effect.

en.在 coaxi 中删除会话只是隐藏，会话及其历史仍然保留。开启后可勾选已删除的会: Deleting a session in coaxi only hides it — the conversation and its history are still here. Turn this on to select deleted sessions and restore them in place.

en.文件太大，无法在此预览。请在工作区打开。: This file is too large to preview here. Open it in the workspace instead.
en.所有文件均为最新版本: All files are up to date
en.以下文件存在冲突，需要手动解决：: The following files have conflicts that need to be resolved:

en.新分支 — 推送以创建远程跟踪分支: New branch — push to create remote tracking branch
en.可从上方分支菜单初始化 Git，或打开已有的 Git 仓库。: Initialize Git from the branch menu above, or open a folder that is already tracked.
en.仅在查看当前分支时可用: Available only when viewing current branch
en.已创建并切换到新分支: Created and switched to new branch
en.HEAD: HEAD
en.将 HEAD 和当前分支指针移动到目标提交。\n暂存区（Index）和工作区（W:
Move HEAD and the current branch pointer to the target commit.
Keep Index and Working Tree unchanged.
Changes from the removed commits stay staged.
en.将 HEAD 移动到目标提交。\n把暂存区重置为目标提交状态，但保留工作区改动。:
Move HEAD to the target commit.
Reset Index to the target commit while keeping Working Tree changes.
Those changes become unstaged.
en.将 HEAD、暂存区和工作区全部重置到目标提交。\n目标提交之后的本地已跟踪改动:
Move HEAD and reset both Index and Working Tree to the target commit.
Local tracked changes after the target commit are discarded.
This is a destructive operation.
en.将 HEAD 移动到目标提交，并尽量保留本地改动。\n仅当本地改动与目标提交不冲:
Move HEAD to the target commit and keep local changes when possible.
Only non-conflicting local changes are preserved.
If conflicts are detected, reset aborts to protect your work.
en.该目录下没有可添加到 VCS 的变更文件: No changed files in this directory can be added to VCS
en.该目录下没有可回滚的变更文件: No changed files in this directory can be rolled back
en.该目录下没有可删除的变更文件: No changed files in this directory can be deleted
en.输入新的名称（仅名称，不含路径）。: Enter a new name (name only, no path).
en.可以在下方修改上传目录，然后添加文件或文件夹。: Adjust the destination if needed, then add files or folders.
en.拖拽文件或文件夹到此处，或使用下方按钮: Drag files or folders here, or use the buttons below
en.释放鼠标以加入上传队列: Release to add to the queue
en.拖放文件到此处，或按回车键浏览: Drop files here or activate to browse
en.拖入的文件夹中没有可上传的文件: No files found in the dropped folder
en.单击分支即可直接比较: Click a branch to compare directly
en.当前文件在磁盘已发生变化，当前编辑内容尚未保存。: Current file has changed on disk, and current edits are unsaved.
en.确定回滚该文件的本地修改吗？: Rollback local changes for this file?
en.其它标签页有未保存更改，确定关闭吗？: Close other tabs with unsaved changes?
en.存在未保存更改，确定关闭全部标签页吗？: Close all tabs with unsaved changes?
en.无法读取当前 Agent 配置。: Unable to read current Agent configuration.
en.正在获取模式和会话配置选项: Fetching mode and session config options
en.开始一个会话后，消息会显示在这里: Start a conversation to see messages here
en.无法读取剪贴板，请改用 Ctrl/⌘V 粘贴。: Couldn't read the clipboard. Press Ctrl/⌘V to paste instead.
en.无法写入剪贴板，请改用键盘快捷键。: Couldn't write to the clipboard. Use the keyboard shortcut instead.
en.智能体工作时可发送: Available while the agent is working
en.已转入队列——将随下一回合发送。: Queued instead — it will be sent with the next turn.
en.无法插入当前回合: Couldn't insert into the current turn
en.图片仍在上传中，请稍候再发送。: Images are still uploading — try again in a moment.
en.还有更多结果，继续输入以筛选: More results — keep typing to filter
en.作为留言，供下次检查时读取: Send as note for next check
Enable at least one agent before starting a session...
en.无法准备聊天会话，请重试。: Couldn't prepare the chat session. Please try again.
en.无法创建会话，请重试。: Couldn't create the conversation. Please try again.
en.右键点击会话标签选择「平铺显示」，可同屏对比多个会话: Right-click any conversation tab and choose Tile Display to see multiple sessions side by side.
en.双击会话标签可将其固定，避免被新打开的会话自动替换: Double-click a conversation tab to pin it, so a newly opened session won't auto-replace it.
en.在输入框输入 / 触发斜杠命令，输入 @ 引用项目内文件: Type / in the input to trigger slash commands, or @ to reference a file from the project.
en.直接粘贴截图或把文件拖到输入框，即可作为附件: Paste a screenshot or drop a file directly onto the input to attach it.
en.智能体回复中也能继续输入并排队，回答完毕会自动续发: While the agent is replying, keep typing — your next message gets queued and auto-sent when it finishes.
en.未发送的草稿会自动保存，重新打开会话仍在: Unsent drafts are auto-saved per conversation and restored when you come back.
en.任意已完成的回复上都有「从此处分叉」，从那条消息开一条新分支: Any completed reply has Fork from here — branch the conversation at that message into a new tab.
en.右键会话内容区可导出为 Markdown / HTML / 图片: Right-click inside the conversation to export it as Markdown, HTML, or an image.
en.在「设置 → 聊天频道」接入 Telegram / 飞书 / 微信，从手机继续操: Connect Telegram / Lark / WeChat under Settings → Chat Channels to continue from your phone.
en.所有快捷键都可在「设置 → 快捷键」中自定义: Every shortcut is fully remappable under Settings → Shortcuts.
en.开启「设置 → Web 服务」后，团队成员可从浏览器接入同一台 coaxi: Enable Settings → Web Service so teammates can reach the same coaxi from a browser.
en.打开文件或差异后，会自动与会话并排显示: Open a file or diff to automatically show it alongside the conversation.
en.点输入框旁的 + 按钮选择「快捷消息」，可一键插入预存片段（在「设置 → 快捷消: Open the + button next to the input and pick Quick Messages to insert a saved snippet (manage them under Settings → Quick Messages).
en.通过 + 按钮里的「专家技能」可一键加载预设角色（调试 / 规划等）: The + button has an Expert Skills menu — preload roles like Debug or Planning with one click.
en.「待办任务」能把一条待办从头跑到尾：智能体在独立工作树里干活，你 review: To-dos run a task end to end — the agent works in its own worktree, then you review the diff and merge.
en.「自动化」按计划定时跑保存好的提示词（比如每晚一次代码评审），还能让每次运行都开: Automations run a saved prompt on a schedule — a nightly review, a recurring report — and each run can get its own worktree.
en.点击状态栏左下角的会话数即可打开「Token 用量」，按天、智能体、模型和文件夹: Click the conversation count in the status bar to open Token Usage — spend broken down by day, agent, model, and folder.
en.@ 不只能引用文件：还能 @ 另一个智能体把子任务交给它，或引用历史会话、某次提: @ pulls in more than files — mention another agent to hand off a subtask, or reference a past session, a commit, or a skill.
en.右键点击标签选择「向右拆分」或「向下拆分」，两个会话各占一个分栏同时开着。: Right-click a tab and pick Split Right or Split Down to keep two conversations open in their own panes.
en.点开分支按钮选「新建工作树」，多个智能体就能在同一个仓库并行干活，互不覆盖彼此的: Open the branch button and pick New worktree so several agents can work the same repo without overwriting each other's files.
en.之前在终端里跑过的会话，用文件夹右键菜单的「导入本地会话」就能把那段历史接进 c: Already ran sessions in the terminal? A folder's menu has Import local sessions — bring that history into coaxi.
en.智能体委派出去的子会话会嵌套显示在侧边栏的父会话下面，展开就能跟踪每一个子会话做: When an agent delegates, the sub-session appears nested under it in the sidebar — expand the row to follow what each one did.
en.「+」菜单里的「实时反馈」能把一条便条塞进智能体正在跑的这一轮，不用打断它。: Live feedback in the + menu drops a note into the turn the agent is already running, without interrupting it.
en.设置 → 技能包 里打包了编程专家、科研和办公三类技能，可以按智能体分别开关。: Settings → Skill Packs bundles coding experts, scientific research, and office skills — switch them on per agent.
en.设置 → 模型供应商 支持填自己的 API key 或接口地址，之后直接在输入框: Settings → Model Providers takes your own API key or endpoint, and you pick the model right in the composer.
en.设置 → 外观 里可以换工作区背景图、调面板不透明度，还能换应用字体。: Settings → Appearance sets a workspace background image, panel opacity, and the app's fonts.

[describe your data, tables, formulas, and charts here]

Create a Word document with the following requirements:

[describe your document content, structure, and formatting here]
